units.source_text: 惟光推想她们是故意装作不辨为谁，

en.t: Koremitsu guessed that they were deliberately pretending not to know who he was,

units.source_text: 答道：“甚好甚好，这叫作‘绿与篱垣两不分’。”

en.t: and replied, "Very good, very good. This is what they call 'green leaves and the hedge indistinguishable.'"

units.source_text: 女主人口上虽然不说，心中却觉得遗憾并且可惜。

en.t: Though the lady of the house said nothing aloud, in her heart she felt regret and disappointment.

units.source_text: 料想她大约已经有了定情的男子，因而有所顾忌吧。

en.t: She supposed the woman must already have a man to whom she had pledged her heart, and so felt some restraint.

units.source_text: 此乃理之当然，惟光也不便再加说明了。

en.t: Since that was only natural, Koremitsu could not very well explain any further.

units.source_text: 在此情况之下，源氏公子立刻想起筑紫的那个善舞的五节，

en.t: Under these circumstances, Prince Genji at once thought of the Gosechi dancer from Tsukushi, who was so skilled at dancing,

units.source_text: 觉得这等身份的女子中，五节倒是可爱的。

en.t: and felt that, among women of that rank, Gosechi was rather charming.

units.source_text: 他在恋爱上，无论对哪一方面，都不断操心，煞是辛苦。

en.t: In matters of love, whichever direction he turned, he was constantly preoccupied and suffered greatly for it.

units.source_text: 凡是与他有过往来的女人，即使经过多年，他还是不能忘怀。

en.t: Any woman who had once had dealings with him, even after many years had passed, he still could not forget.

units.source_text: 这反而变成了许多女人的怨恨的源泉。

en.t: This, in turn, became the source of many women's resentment.
